source.note: the COUNTER dual of the token-doubling modifier (grave-titan-x-anointed-procession, batch 8): a counter-placement REPLACEMENT that multiplies the magnitude of a +1/+1-counter emit (emit:counter -> replace:counterplacement intercept), exactly as Anointed Procession's replace:token-creation multiplied a token emit. Same STRUCTURAL modifier arm (mechanism=modifier, ADR-0001 §4, CR 614) -> NO new rule; a distinct-family witness (counters STATE stem instead of the deployment EVENT stem). Oracle text verified vs oracle-cards.json 2026-07-17: Titania's Boon = 'Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.'; Doubling Season = 'If an effect would create one or more tokens under your control, it creates twice that many of those tokens instead. / If an effect would put one or more counters on a permanent you control, it puts twice that many of those counters on that permanent instead.' (its SECOND line is the counter-doubling replacement). Live/ground ports: Doubling Season line 1 projects replace:counterplacement (dumps/card-ports.json: family=replacement, side=intercept, oracleLineIndex=1, Green) -- the clean-parsing doubler, the exact dual of Anointed Procession's replace:token-creation intercept. Titania's Boon is not in the corpus dump but is an ALREADY-WITNESSED gold (titanias-boon single-card): T0 = emit STATE counters +1/+1 control=you, hand-parsed faithfully at Fixtures/HandParsedCards/TitaniasBoon.json -- reused here as the proven counter SOURCE. PARSE-GAP NOTE (not this gold's card): the pure +1/+1 counter-doublers Branching Evolution / Corpsejack Menace and the counter-adder Hardened Scales all project emit:unstructured in the dump (parser gap) -- Doubling Season's counter arm is the only counter-doubler that currently parses to replace:counterplacement, which is why it is the chosen doubler. Not a CSB combo (a synergy, not a loop) -> no popularity.

judge.ref: interaction-judge PASS (accretion batch 10, 2026-07-17): 9/9 PASS, no false GREEN. Both new recast members (policy:recast:graveyard-cast, policy:recast:permanent-bounce) ruled genuinely distinct (from-zone/end-state/consume-side); persist ruled a correct corroboration of policy:recur:death-return-self + guard:undying-counter-reset (sign-of-counter differs, mechanism identical), not a sibling.

Titania's Boon.note: THE COUNTER SOURCE -- 'put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control' emits the counters STATE resource (CR 122.1). counter-type=+1/+1, qty=1, control=you. Byte-identical port shape to the titanias-boon single-card gold's T0 (the proven, hand-parsed counters emit at Fixtures/HandParsedCards/TitaniasBoon.json) -- reused here as the emit that the doubler intercepts. The counters land on creatures you control (creature is a permanent), so they fall inside Doubling Season's 'a permanent you control' watch.

Doubling Season.note: 'If an effect would put one or more counters on a permanent you control, it puts twice that many of those counters on that permanent instead' -- a CR 614.1 replacement watching the counter-placement of the counters STATE resource. Dump: replace:counterplacement (family=replacement, side=intercept, oracleLineIndex=1, Green). control=you is the load-bearing filter; NO counter-type restriction (Doubling Season doubles ALL counter types, so +1/+1 is trivially covered). The COUNTER dual of Anointed Procession A1 (intercept EVENT deployment / replace:token-creation): here the intercept is on the counters STATE stem, a doubler (not an adder) whose magnitude is card-defined, not port-structural.

notes: the ADR-0001 §4 modifier arm, COUNTER dual of grave-titan-x-anointed-procession E1: a counters emit (emit:counter:+1/+1, control=you) is intercepted by a counter-placement replacement (CR 614.1 -- Doubling Season watches the event of putting counters on a permanent you control and replaces it with twice that many). control=you covers control=you -> the mandatory replacement applies -> GREEN. mechanism=modifier is structural/self-certifying (like subsumption/card-defined) -> NO rule id, NO new rule declared; it multiplies the MAGNITUDE (qty) of the emit via single-referent stem-cover (the intercept watches the SAME resource the emitter emits -- the counters STATE stem), exactly the shape the token-doubling modifier witnessed on the deployment EVENT stem. Distinct from policy:trigger-multiplier:firing-cover (Teysa), which multiplies the FIRINGS of a subscription via a dual-referent match -- this multiplies the magnitude of a single emit.
Intercept never closes a loop alone (CR 614.5 -- a replacement gets only one opportunity and does not re-invoke itself, so the doubled counters are not re-doubled). unit=pairwise, no_loop.

assertions.because: the emit:counter -> replace:counterplacement intercept relation is the structural §4 modifier arm (single-referent stem-cover, the intercept watches the same counters STATE resource the emitter emits); self-certifying, no rule cited, no new rule -- the counter dual of grave-titan-x-anointed-procession's emit:token -> replace:token-creation modifier.

control=you covers control=you and a counter-placement replacement is mandatory (CR 614.1, no 'may'); Doubling Season deterministically intercepts Titania's Boon's +1/+1-counter placement and doubles it. counter-type is trivially covered (Doubling Season doubles ALL counter types).
unit=pairwise: a one-shot magnitude modifier, not a repeating cycle (CR 614.5 -- the replacement gets one opportunity and does not re-double its own doubled output); no §10 SDF balance.
